Job Description At DPR, roles and responsibilities are more than describing a job title—they are a commitment to building great things together. The job description(s) below defines core responsibilities and the scope of the role and is a starting point. Every employee is expected to lead from where they are, take ownership of outcomes, and always act in the best interest of the team, customer, project and organization. As a purpose-driven organization on a journey to be most admired, we rely on trust, shared leadership, open communication, disciplined action and a deep respect for the individual to drive exceptional performance. Success is not just about what we build, but who we build and how we build it: with integrity, enjoyment, uniqueness and an ever-forward mindset.
Job Summary Monitors the development and optimization of moderately complex project schedules to drive successful and timely project delivery. Partners with leadership and cross-functional teams to align scheduling strategies with organizational priorities and resource planning. Evaluates project performance metrics to identify trends, anticipate and mitigate risks, and recommend strategic adjustments for enhanced outcomes. Proactively documents, escalates, and communicates schedule constraints, risks, and issues, influencing timely decision-making and resolution across project teams. Utilizes leading practices in planning and scheduling, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence. Influences the planning and scheduling function by collaborating across teams and providing guidance to peers and less experienced team members.
Key Responsibilities Designs, develops, maintains, implements, and monitors comprehensive project schedules for multiple or large-scale initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives.
Collaborates with project teams and external partners to resolve moderately complex scheduling challenges and optimize resource allocation.
Analyzes project data and performance indicators to forecast risks, develop mitigation strategies, and drive informed decision-making.
Communicates schedule status, critical path updates, and potential impacts to senior stakeholders with clarity and confidence.
Ensures compliance with established scheduling standards, methodologies, and documentation requirements.
Leads post-project reviews to capture lessons learned and integrate improvements into future planning processes.
Supports less experienced team members in planning and scheduling issues and provides technical expertise based on leading practices.
Education Qualifications Bachelor's degree in engineering, project management, a related field, or equivalent experience required.
Work Experience 4 - 6 years of experience in project planning, scheduling, or a related field required.
Anticipated starting pay range: $149,000.00- $220,000.00
Nothing is more important than your health and wellness. DPR offers a variety of medical, dental, vision and wellness benefits to keep you healthy. Read more about eligibility and available benefits programs for skilled craft and labor or experienced professionals and recent graduates.

Founded in 1990, DPR is a great story of entrepreneurial success as a private, employee-owned company that has grown into a multi-billion-dollar family of companies with offices around the world.
Working at DPR, you'll have the chance to try new things, explore unique paths and shape your future. $30 - $34 per hour

TEEMA GROUP

### Job Description

Job Description

Senior Center Operations Coordinator – San Francisco, CA

**Location:** San Francisco, CA – 30th Street Center

**Pay:** $30.00–$34.00/hour

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, Day Shift

**Work Setting:** 100% Onsite

**Assignment:** 3-Month Contract with Potential for Extension

**Language Requirement:** Bilingual English/Spanish OR English/Cantonese

We are urgently seeking a compassionate and highly organized **Senior Center Operations Coordinator** to support daily operations and programming at a busy senior center in San Francisco.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working directly with **older adults and diverse communities** and has experience with senior services, recreational programming, community-based programs, or senior center operations.

The ideal candidate is energetic, dependable, culturally responsive, and comfortable balancing participant engagement, programming, administrative responsibilities, safety, and day-to-day center operations.

Key Responsibilities

- Support daily operations of a high-volume senior center and help maintain a safe, welcoming, and organized environment.

- Engage directly with older adults and provide excellent participant and customer service.

- Coordinate and support recreational activities, educational workshops, wellness programs, classes, and group programming.

- Assist with participant enrollment, referrals, outreach, and program-related services.

- Coordinate activity and workshop schedules and help ensure appropriate program coverage.

- Support volunteers, staff, community partners, and security personnel with daily center activities.

- Assist with building safety, security, and Staff-on-Duty responsibilities.

- Use effective conflict-resolution and de-escalation techniques when participant or operational challenges arise.

- Provide language assistance and translation support for monolingual participants when needed.

- Maintain accurate participant information, program documentation, reports, and operational records.

- Assist with community outreach, site visits, program assessments, and surveys.

- Coordinate program supplies and inventory, including ordering and receiving materials.

- Assist with donation collections and related financial documentation.

- Provide administrative and operational support as needed.

- Follow established policies, procedures, contract requirements, and regulatory standards.

- Travel to other local service sites within San Francisco when needed.


Required Qualifications

- **Bilingual fluency in English/Spanish OR English/Cantonese is required.**

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

- Strong customer service, interpersonal, collaboration, and communication skills.

- Ability to work effectively with culturally and linguistically diverse populations.

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- Comfortable working independently and following detailed procedures.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office and familiarity with database systems.

- Ability to stand for prolonged periods and occasionally lift up to 50 lbs.

- Must be able to work **100% onsite in San Francisco** .


Preferred Qualifications

- Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Recreation, Recreation Administration, Gerontology, Human Services, Social Services, Nonprofit Administration, or a related field.

- At least **1 year of experience working directly with older adults or seniors** .

- Experience in senior centers, recreational programming, community-based programs, or similar environments.

- At least **1 year of community outreach experience** .

- Experience coordinating activities, workshops, volunteers, or group programming.

- Experience with conflict resolution and de-escalation.

- Diabetes Educator or Health Educator certification is a plus.


Why Consider This Opportunity?

This position offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the lives of older adults while supporting a vibrant community-based senior center. You will work directly with participants, staff, volunteers, and community partners to help ensure programs run smoothly and the center remains **safe, welcoming, inclusive, and well-organized** .

The Variel of Woodland Hills

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

### Job Description

Job Description

Description:

**Position Title** : Accounting Assistant

**Department** : Accounting

**Status** : Part-Time Monday-Friday

**Exempt Status** :  Non-Exempt

**Supervisor** :  Business Office Director

**Support the Details That Keep Us Running**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Accounting Assistant to support the day-to-day financial operations of our senior living community. This position will assist with Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, vendor coordination, reconciliations, and month-end close.

The ideal candidate has senior living accounting experience, Yardi experience, and a strong commitment to accuracy and timely follow-through.

**About the Variel**

We believe the later chapters of life deserve to be lived with purpose, comfort, and connection. The Variel is a modern senior living community in the heart of Woodland Hills, built on a simple conviction: exceptional senior living should offer the same warmth, quality, and attention to detail found in a luxury hotel.

Our residents are more than customers, they are our neighbors, friends, and community. Every interaction, experience, and detail matters, from the care we provide to the way we welcome residents and their families each day.

At The Variel, we value genuine hospitality, teamwork, compassion, and accountability. We treat each other the way we wish to be treated in return, and we are committed to creating an environment where our residents and our team members can thrive.

**About the location**

Set at 6233 Variel Avenue in the Warner Center district of Woodland Hills, The Variel offers a vibrant setting surrounded by shopping, dining, entertainment, and the best of the West San Fernando Valley. With Westfield Topanga, local farmers markets, parks, and everyday conveniences just minutes away, our community provides residents with a comfortable and connected lifestyle. Designed with modern living in mind, The Variel combines thoughtful amenities, inviting spaces, and exceptional service to create an environment that feels welcoming, sophisticated, and distinctly like home.

**Position**

The Accounting Assistant provides day-to-day accounting support with a focus on Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, reconciliations, vendor documentation, and month-end close. This position helps maintain accurate financial records and ensures accounting transactions and required documentation are completed accurately and on time.

**What You'll Do**

**Responsibilities**

- Review and process invoices and check requests for proper documentation, coding, and approvals.
- Enter invoices, payments, and Accounts Receivable transactions into Yardi.
- Prepare and reconcile deposits and payments.
- Assist with bank and check reconciliations and monthly journal entries.
- Support month-end close and account analysis.
- Maintain accurate accounting records, files, and supporting documentation.
- Collect W-9s, contracts, and other required vendor documentation.
- Respond to vendor inquiries and assist with resolving discrepancies.
- Follow up on Long-Term Care payments and required documentation.
- Provide accounting support to department leaders and employees.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

**Qualifications**

- Minimum 1 year of Yardi accounting experience.
- Senior living accounting experience required.
- Working knowledge of Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
- Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.
- Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.
- Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field preferred; equivalent experience may be considered

We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws, including but not to limited, respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions. # Senior Full-Charge Bookkeeper - QuickBooks Online Expert

BOOKKEEPING ENTERPRISES

[Tustin, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Tustin%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7591897014698006709?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7015&pageType=7&jobAge=402&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-6828515072364387854&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

Bookkeeping Enterprises is looking for an **experienced Senior Full-Charge Bookkeeper** who knows bookkeeping inside and out and can confidently manage multiple sets of books with minimal supervision.

**This is not an entry-level bookkeeping position.**

We're looking for someone who can look at a set of books, recognize when something isn't right, determine why, and fix it. You should have strong technical bookkeeping skills, excellent attention to detail, and **advanced hands-on QuickBooks experience** .

We specialize in bookkeeping—not tax preparation or CPA services. We want someone who has made bookkeeping their specialty and is exceptionally good at it.

**This position is 100% on-site in Orange County. Remote and hybrid work are not available.**

**What You'll Do**

As a Senior Full-Charge Bookkeeper, you will be responsible for managing the day-to-day and month-end bookkeeping needs of multiple clients.

**Responsibilities include:**

- Manage full-cycle bookkeeping for multiple clients
- Maintain and review general ledgers
- Perform bank, credit card, and loan reconciliations
- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable
- Record, classify, and review transactions for accuracy
- Prepare and post journal entries and adjusting entries
- Payroll entries and payroll reconciliations
- Review Balance Sheets and Profit & Loss statements for accuracy
- Reconcile balance sheet accounts and investigate discrepancies
- Perform bookkeeping cleanup and catch-up projects
- Identify errors, unusual balances, duplicate transactions, and misclassifications
- Complete month-end bookkeeping and prepare financial reports
- Maintain accurate supporting documentation and client records
- Communicate with clients regarding missing information and bookkeeping questions
- Manage multiple client accounts, priorities, and deadlines
- Prepare clean and accurate books for year-end handoff to clients' tax professionals

**Who We're Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

- **5+ years of hands-on bookkeeping/accounting experience**

- Full-charge or senior-level bookkeeping experience
- Excellent understanding of debits, credits, and general ledger accounting
- Strong bank, credit card, and loan reconciliation skills
- Experience reviewing Balance Sheets and Profit & Loss statements
- Ability to identify and correct bookkeeping errors independently
- Experience with month-end close and account reconciliation
- Ability to manage multiple companies or client files simultaneously
- Strong organizational and time-management skills
- Exceptional attention to detail
- Professional written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to work independently without requiring constant supervision
- Reliable, accountable, and comfortable working in a deadline-driven environment

**Especially Valuable Experience**

- QuickBooks Online/Desktop Certification
- Bookkeeping cleanup/catch-up projects
- Sales & Use Tax Filings
- Workers Comp Audits
- Multi-entity or multi-client bookkeeping
- Working in a bookkeeping, accounting, or professional-services firm

**What This Position Is NOT**

This is **not a tax preparation position** , and CPA credentials are not required.

We're specifically looking for an experienced **bookkeeping professional** who enjoys the hands-on work of maintaining accurate books, solving discrepancies, and providing clients with reliable financial information.

**Why Work at Bookkeeping Enterprises?**

At Bookkeeping Enterprises, you'll gain experience that's difficult to get working in one accounting department at a single company.

- **Exposure to dozens of businesses and industries.** You'll work with a diverse client base, giving you hands-on experience with different business models, accounting challenges, and financial structures.
- **Broaden your accounting expertise.** Rather than being limited to one function or department, you'll be exposed to the full accounting cycle and a wide variety of real-world accounting situations.
- **Continue learning and growing.** Managing multiple sets of books will strengthen your troubleshooting, problem-solving, and financial analysis skills while making you a more well-rounded accounting professional.
- **Build a career with us.** As Bookkeeping Enterprises grows, the right person will have opportunities to take on greater responsibility, mentor team members, oversee client relationships, and advance into a **leadership or management position** .

If you're an experienced bookkeeper who enjoys variety, solving problems, and continually expanding your skills, this is an opportunity to **grow beyond maintaining one company's books and build a much broader accounting career.**

**We are actively interviewing and intend to fill this position as soon as possible.**

## Description:

**Senior Manager/Manager, Marketing**

AlphaDetect — Durham, NC

AlphaDetect is a non-profit organization powered by the Alpha-1 Foundation, solely dedicated to advancing the detection of Alpha-1, a genetic, progressive, and irreversible condition that affects the lungs and liver. As a mission-driven, rapidly growing organization, we are building a trusted, innovative, and collaborative organization focused on accelerating answers to inform decisions.

We are seeking a self-starter HCP-focused marketer with experience in healthcare, biotech, or medical device environments to help build our Marketing team and grow our organization. This role is an in-office position that can either be full-time or part-time. This is an ideal role for a marketer who thrives in a mission-driven, collaborative, fast-paced environment and is excited to help shape a company’s voice and impact.

**Role Overview**

The Senior Marketing Manager (or Marketing Manager, experience dependent) will support the development and own the execution of AlphaDetect’s HCP marketing and communication strategy, with the opportunity to expand into direct-to-patient marketing for rare disease detection.

This role blends hands-on content development, project management, cross-functional collaboration, and strong execution skills to ensure messaging is clear, consistent, and drives behavior change toward increased genetic testing.

You will work closely with executive leadership, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and external partners from day one to elevate disease state education and detection options, strengthen provider engagement, and support initiatives that serve the Alpha-1 community. This is a high-visibility role with the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Marketing & Brand Communications

- Execute the HCP marketing tactical plan under the guidance of senior leadership, translating strategy into clear, compelling, and compliant marketing materials within a lean non-profit budget
- Ensure consistency in messaging, tone, and brand identity across all communication channels
- Lead and execute the communications strategy, including social media initiatives, particularly LinkedIn, in alignment with industry best practices
- Collaborate cross-functionally, including with the Alpha-1 Foundation and industry sponsors, to support integrated and aligned messaging across initiatives

2\. Content Development & Campaign Execution

- Demonstrate a builder mindset, using WordPress, Canva, AI tools, etc. technologies to independently develop marketing assets, maintain web content, and execute campaigns in a cost-effective, high-impact manner.
- Partner with internal teams and external agencies to launch and optimize disease state education and genetic testing initiatives
- Develop and execute core HCP assets such as brochures, video content, and promotional materials while ensuring alignment with brand strategy
- Support the planning and execution of HCP congress presence, sponsorships, and related marketing initiatives within budget parameters
- Provide executional support for ad boards and peer-to-peer program development and associated content creation

3\. Project Management & Operational Coordination

- Manage marketing project timelines, deliverables, budgets, and cross-functional communication to ensure successful execution of initiatives
- Oversee inventory management for genetic sample collection kits and promotional materials
- Coordinate with external vendors to support marketing programs efficiently
- Facilitate collaboration among internal stakeholders, agencies, and vendors to maintain project alignment and operational effectiveness

**Qualifications**

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field
- At least 2 years of marketing experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or medical devices is a must
- 1–3 years of communications or digital content creation experience is a bonus
- Basic understanding of brand, marketing, and content development
- Strong written and verbal communication skills; PR and media experience a plus
- Familiarity with social media best practices, specifically LinkedIn
- Detail-oriented with strong project management and executional skills
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines
- Hands-on execution
- Can work in ambiguity/launch environment
- Creative thinker with a willingness to learn and take initiative
- Proven ability to collaborate and engage within an office environment
- Able to travel as needed to key US-based congresses/meetings (~20%)

**Why Join AlphaDetect?**

- Be an integral part of a newly launched mission-driven organization accelerating detection of a genetic condition
- Contribute to meaningful work that directly impacts patients, families, and healthcare providers
- Work in a collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation, integrity, and compassion
- Grow your career as AlphaDetect expands its programs, partnerships, and national reachitiatives and

# Senior Executive Assistant - Citi

Location:Hayes Valley, CACompany:Citi

## Description:

**Discover your future at Citi**

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**

The Senior Executive Assistant provides support to another individual or group of individuals by handling correspondence, managing calendars and appointments, arranging conferences and conference calls, making travel arrangements and providing other administrative tasks.

**Responsibilities:**

- Directly supports a C16 level manager and generally supports an entire department
- Manages day to day calendar(s) of senior management
- Coordinates all aspects of executive level manager appointments, meetings, receptions and conference calls
- May prepare and review materials and correspondence for meetings
- Assist with creation/modification of presentations, spreadsheets, and other various documents
- Coordinates travel arrangements; prepare and distribute schedules/agendas for travel
- Prepares, reconciles, and tracks expense reports through Travel and Entertainment Expense system
- Orders supplies and process invoices through Procure to Pay system
- Process and follow-up on Virtual Requests
- Assists in ad-hoc reports special projects as needed
- Trains, coaches or guides other administrative staff when required
- Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

**Qualifications:**

- Previous office administration experience preferably within a large and complex financial services or similar organization
- Highly proficient in Microsoft Office
- Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
- Demonstrated ability to quickly gain command of new systems
- Self-motivated and detail oriented

**Education:**

- Bachelor's/University degree or equivalent experience

# Scheduler III

Location:Alhambra, CACompany:Pacific Pros

## Description:

Job DescriptionJob Description **Benefits:**

- 401(k)
- 401(k) matching
- Dental insurance
- Health insurance
- Paid time off
- Vision insurance

Pacific Pros is seeking **Scheduler III** for **Construction Projects** to be a representative for COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES, DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS.

**Work Location: LAWA has required the candidates be local for this position**.

**Region: Los Angeles, CA**

**Status: Full-time on-site.**

**Opening: Start date will be sometime between April 2026 through July 2026**

**Required Qualifications**

- Minimum of 15 years working in the construction project management field.
- Effective oral and written communication skills.
- Demonstrate positive attitude and excellence in customer service.
- Detail oriented with effective organization and coordination skills.
- Ability to be flexible/adaptable in evolving procedures and work under pressure to meet critical deadlines.
- Proactive in taking initiatives to seek solutions with minimum, vague, and/or conflicting guidelines.
- Experience working in a cohesive team environment.
- Proficient in using Microsoft Office software (Teams, SharePoint, Power BI, Project, Word, Excel, Outlook, OneNote, PowerPoint).
- Experience in working with capital and public works projects.
- Experience in drafting and editing status reports, meeting minutes, memos, and letters.
- Experience in assisting project team to keep management informed on project progress.

**Scope of Work**

- Responsible for analysis and review of construction schedules (baseline/updates) and Time Impact Analysis (TIA) reports
- Prepare the master and detailed time schedules
- Input resources, costs, project budget, performance percent complete for EVM reports, resource assignments, and leveling.
- Utilize Critical Path Method and milestones plan for monitoring deliverables
- Time and cost control for all sub-contracts, sub-suppliers, and stakeholders for the prime contract.
- Prepare cash flow and dedicated charts, progress meeting schedule, daily, weekly, and monthly reports, documents and correspondences, and contracts control and management.
- Monitor project progress against a determined baseline. Prepare analysis for staff and stakeholders and identifying critical paths, near critical paths, milestone impacts, phasing shifts, and potential trends.
- Provide impact analysis of schedule changes, identify schedule variances and opportunities, and develops mitigation plans for the Project Management team.
- Provide reporting documents and briefing materials. Develops creative reporting tools to communicate complex project sequencing and/or progress assessments. Responsible for promptly reporting schedule interruptions or other variances.
- Prepares detailed plans and time scaled charts and diagrams for executive review and presentation.
- Maintain simplified logic schedules to highlight status of key interfaces for critical path review.
- Review design and/or construction schedules and provide written comments, Coordinates schedule comments and corrections with Contractor.
- Advises senior project management team of schedule performance issues.
- Evaluate requests for time extensions. Perform windows analyses and prepare write-ups with executive recommendations for action.
- Develop and maintain detailed construction planning schedules for new construction and renovation work.

# Executive Assistant to the Chief Product Officer

Location:San Jose, CACompany:Western Digital

## Description:

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced **Executive Assistant** to support the **Chief Product Officer** of Western Digital.

Reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer, you will serve as a strategic partner to the executive and partner closely with the CPO’s Chief of Staff. You will support the Product organization and collaborate closely with senior leaders across Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, Sales, and Corporate Functions.

In this highly visible role, you will be entrusted with confidential information and play a critical role in ensuring the efficiency and effectiveness of the CPO's office. You will anticipate needs, exercise judgement, manage competing priorities, and help drive operational excellence across a fast-paced, global organization. Success in this position requires exceptional organizational skills, sound business judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to build trusted relationships across all levels of the company.

The ideal candidate is proactive, resourceful, highly collaborative, and thrives in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift quickly. They are adept at leveraging modern productivity tools to improve efficiency, decision support, and execution. Supporting a global executive will require flexibility, adaptability, and exceptional self-management skills.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Executive Time and Priority Management**

- Manage and optimize the CPO's calendar, ensuring alignment with product, business, and company priorities.
- Proactively identify scheduling conflicts, prioritize meetings, and maximize executive productivity across multiple time zones.
- Develop a strong understanding of business priorities to effectively guide scheduling decisions and meeting prioritization.
- Anticipate executive needs and recommend solutions to ensure seamless execution of priorities.

**Product Leadership Coordination**

- Partner with the Product Leadership Team to coordinate and execute operating rhythms, leadership meetings, product reviews, roadmap planning sessions, quarterly business reviews, and strategic planning activities.
- Ensure appropriate preparation, documentation, and follow-up actions for key product and executive forums.
- Drive accountability for action items, milestones, and deliverables resulting from leadership meetings and strategic initiatives.

**Meeting Planning and Organization**

- Plan and execute internal and external meetings, leadership offsites, customer engagements, analyst briefings, board-related product reviews, and team events.
- Coordinate agendas, logistics, meeting materials, and action-item tracking.
- Support planning and execution of organizational events and leadership forums.

**Executive Communications**

- Serve as a key point of contact for the Office of the Chief Product Officer.
- Manage communications, inquiries, approvals, and requests on behalf of the executive, as appropriate.
- Foster effective communication between the Product organization and cross-functional stakeholders.
- Ensure communications produced on behalf of the executive are accurate, professional, and aligned with business priorities.

**Business Operations and Tool Management**

- Manage expense reports, purchase orders, statements of work, and other operational processes in compliance with company policies.
- Utilize and champion productivity tools including Microsoft 365, Copilot, WD Chat, SharePoint, Teams, and other internal systems.
- Identify opportunities to streamline administrative processes and improve organizational effectiveness through automation and AI-enabled tools.

**Executive Briefings and Content Preparation**

- Coordinate executive briefing materials for internal leadership meetings, customer visits, industry events, analyst engagements, and business travel in partnership with the Chief of Staff, Executive Communications, and other key stakeholders.
- Ensure briefing materials, presentations, meeting summaries, and supporting documentation are organized, complete, and available to the CPO in advance of key engagements.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

- Partner with leaders across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Corporate Functions to drive alignment on strategic initiatives and organizational priorities.
- Build trusted relationships with executives, stakeholders, and cross-functional leaders.
- Support execution of strategic product initiatives, organizational priorities, and special projects.

**Travel Management**

- Manage complex domestic and international travel.
- Balancing executive priorities, time-zone considerations, and seamless logistics.

**Team Leadership and Community Engagement**

- Provide leadership and functional oversight for EAs across the Product organization, including resource allocation, workload balancing, role scoping, and ongoing performance feedback.
- Own EA team culture, employee engagement initiatives, leadership events, and organizational communications.
- Foster collaboration and best practice sharing across the Executive Assistant community.
- Contribute to a high-performing, service-oriented culture within the broader organization.
- Build strong partnerships within the executive assistant community and contribute to best practice sharing across the company.

Beacon Hill

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-9216986314353792245?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8789874494651077401&crId=US_0US_0)

Our client is seeking a temporary (Minimum of 40 days) dependable, polished, and poised individual who is a self-starter with the ability to provide a high level of customer service. The Administrative Coordinator directly supports the Office Administrator and acts as the first impression and point of contact for visitors. This individual is responsible for escorting guests to conference rooms and providing business center support such as arranging catering, coordinating transportation, and more.
This position requires in-office attendance Monday through Friday from 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM. Overtime and schedule flexibility may be required from time to time.
Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To: Greet clients and visitors and follow office security procedures and protocols for all visitors, ensuring guests are identified and properly escorted.
Assist with scheduling conference rooms utilizing online tools and work with internal teams and IT to ensure seamless client services, including food orders, video conferencing, and technology support.
Remain current with the structure of the organization, including departments, offices, and key personnel.
Provide concierge-style client services, including arranging hotels, restaurants, travel, boarding passes, transportation, entertainment, and more.
Prepare budgets and assist in securing vendors for office events.
Coordinate logistics for administrative meetings and events, including trainings, special projects, and team events.
Assist the Office Administrator with the coordination and execution of sponsorships, client-development activities, and other special events.
Reconcile invoices and credit card statements and process payments through the expense management system.
Manage requests for visiting employee offices and workspace accommodations.
Manage visitor access badges, including issuing, tracking, and canceling access.
Maintain office parking validation records.
Submit office maintenance requests through the building management system.
Support additional responsibilities and special projects as assigned.
Qualifications Minimum of 1-3 years of customer service, hospitality, reception, or office support experience in a professional office environment.
High school diploma required; Bachelor's degree preferred.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with executives, clients, and colleagues.
Professional, positive attitude and strong commitment to customer service.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
Experience utilizing online resources for research, reservations, and service coordination.
Event coordination experience is a plus.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining composure in a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated initiative, strong work ethic, and willingness to learn.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Reliable, punctual, and dependable.
Beacon Hill is an equal opportunity employer and individuals with disabilities and/or protected veterans are encouraged to apply.
California residents: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.
Completion of this form is voluntary and will not affect your opportunity for employment, or the terms or conditions of your employment. This form will be used for reporting purposes only and will be kept separate from all other records.
Company Profile: Founded by industry leaders to set a new standard in search, career placement and flexible staffing, we deliver coordinated staffing solutions with unparalleled service, a commitment to project completion and success and a passion for innovation, creativity and continuous improvement.
Our niche brands offer a complete suite of staffing services to emerging growth companies and the Fortune 500 across market sectors, career specialties/disciplines and industries. Over time, office locations, specialty practice areas and service offerings will be added to address ever changing constituent needs.

Upon successfully being hired, details will be provided related to our benefit offerings.

Application Deadline: 15 November 2025
Department: Federal Services
Location: Washington, DC

Description
TeleSolv Consulting is seeking a Master Scheduler for a new contract/project with their Federal Government Agency client. Below are some details regarding the overall project. This position will be considered \\"remote\\" or \\"telework\\" but will include up to 15% travel to client sites.
The U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), Office of Facilities & Asset Management (OFAM), Operational Support Facilities Directorate (OSF), Border Patrol and Air & Marine (BPAM) Program Management Office (PMO) manages the planning, construction and sustainment of real, physical property for the United States Border Patrol (USBP) and Air and Marine Operations (AMO) facilities.
This includes project management, construction management, sustainment planning, financial and business solutions, and the program oversight, planning and coordination of all real property activities for USBP and AMO. The PMO is also responsible for creating continuous and viable solutions for developing, executing, and managing on-going initiatives (including program management planning, program analysis, project management and analysis, construction oversight, and scheduling, security, and risk management) required to support the facilities needs of its customers.
Key Responsibilities
• Develop and maintain project and program schedules using Primavera and Microsoft Project software.
• Review and evaluate project schedules and Project Requirement Documents (PRDs) for accuracy and logic.
• Ensure schedules meet project requirements and identify interdependencies across projects.
• Produce integrated schedules and Progress Variance Reports for Federal Government review.
• Update schedules monthly and submit performance measure reports including progress, cost, and slippage data.
• Assist project managers in schedule corrections and milestone tracking throughout the project lifecycle.
• Notify Federal Government client of any deviations from current schedules and recommend corrective actions.
• Provide monthly electronic submissions of approved integrated schedules to the Government client.
Required and Preferred Skills
Required:
• Must currently be a U.S. Citizen
• The ability to obtain and maintain a Tier 4 or Tier 5 Public Trust clearance
• Master’s degree in Project Management, Engineering, or related field
• 10+ years of experience in project scheduling and project management, including with a Federal Government Agency preferably with CBP (Customs and Border Protection)
• Proficiency in Primavera and Microsoft Project - BOTH are required
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Experience in construction scheduling and federal project environments, particularly experience scheduling 40+ projects of various scopes & sizes simultaneously
• Ability to work independently and remotely with minimal supervision
Preferred:
• Experience working with federal government agencies such as USACE, GSA, or FAA
• Familiarity with CBP systems including TRIRIGA and SAP
• PMP certification or equivalent project management credential
• Experience in risk management and performance reporting
Benefits
Paid Time Off (PTO)
Paid Federal holidays
Medical Insurance
Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
401k + matching

About TeleSolv :
Join the TeleSolv Team on our mission to provide quality and unparalleled service to our clients. We are a growing organization that provides a variety of professional and administrative services to public and private organizations with global operations. Rated in the top 1000 businesses in 2019 by Inc.com. Since its founding in 2000, TeleSolv has been committed to helping organizations solve complex problems. Our solutions integrate sound management principles with the most appropriate technologies to assist senior executives in effectively managing programmatic, schedule, and technical risks. TeleSolv offers excellent compensation, training, advancement opportunities, and exceptional benefits including PTO, sick leave, up to 11 paid federal holidays, medical, dental, vision, company paid life, short-term and long-term disability insurance, employee assistance program, and matching 401(k) plan.

# Planner-Scheduler (Construction Management)

$134.95k - $148.8k

Orange County Sanitation District

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-8409630025289809857?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=1395104198160946228&crId=US_0US_0)

What do you value in your next job?

Integrity, Inclusion, Honesty, and Respect. We strive to demonstrate these values in our actions, commitments, and service. Leadership, Teamwork, and Problem Solving. Safety. We are committed to providing a safe work environment. OC San is currently looking to fill the role of Planner-Scheduler (Construction Management)
Under general supervision, performs a variety of duties involving the scheduling of major OC San wastewater treatment and collection systems construction and maintenance projects; manages field contractors’ schedules to evaluate contractor performance against established standards; establishes clear specifications and enforcement provisions with contractors by placing schedule performance and proof of impact on the contractors; analyzes and monitors time impact delays, determines compensability to the contractor, and the impact on current projects and general operations; and performs duties as assigned.

Prepares and analyzes construction schedules and cost reports to determine feasibility of proposed schedules; distributes progress evaluations to project managers and engineers.

Reviews and analyzes monthly construction schedule updates and progress payments; monitors actual progress versus planned progress, provides exception reporting, and recommends action steps to resolve issues.

Acts as a liaison on scheduling matters between different OC San divisions and departments; coordinates construction project schedules to minimize the impacts on wastewater facilities and systems operations due to planned construction projects.

Reviews baseline schedules and design submittals prior to bid to ensure scope is achievable in the time stipulated; identifies the critical path of the project and work sequencing; creates preliminary construction schedules during project planning phases.

Reviews contract change orders and provides recommendations on issues involving construction delays.

Performs project schedule delay impact analysis of project schedule changes; assesses chronology of events and reviews project delays to determine compensable and non-compensable claims.

Attends contractor meetings; provides schedule risk analysis; assists with establishing schedule milestones for assigned projects and recommends key performance indicators required for Project Management Office reporting; participates in the development and implementation of standards used; researches and recommends quality improvement standards.

Performs duties as assigned.

**Required:**

Bachelor’s degree from a college or university accredited by the U.S. Department of Education, with major coursework in engineering, construction management, or a related field.

Three (3) years of professional engineering or construction management work experience involving the planning and scheduling of large construction projects.

Desired

Detailed knowledge of project management principles, the critical path method, and work breakdown structures.

A strong understanding of project scheduling and budgeting.

Advanced knowledge of CPM and Primavera P6 Project Management, Microsoft Project, and Excel.

Vacancies: 1

APPLICATION FILING DEADLINE: Thursday, November 12, 2026, 5:00 P.M. (or until a sufficient number of qualified applications have been received)

Hiring Salary Range: $134,950.40 – $148,803.20/Year (starting salary will be within this range based upon qualifications)

## PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Mobility to work in a standard office setting and use standard office equipment, including a computer; visit various OC San sites, projects, and/or meetings; primarily a sedentary office classification although standing in work areas and walking between work areas may be required; occasionally bend, stoop, kneel, reach, push, and pull drawers open and closed to retrieve and file information; ability to lift, carry, push, and pull materials and objects up to 35 pounds.

Mobility to work in changing site conditions; to sit, stand, and walk on level, uneven, or slippery surfaces; to reach, twist, turn, kneel, and bend.

Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen.

Vision to inspect site conditions and work in progress.

Hearing and speech to communicate in person and over the telephone.

Finger dexterity is needed to access, enter, and retrieve data using a computer keyboard or calculator and to operate standard office equipment.

Field work requiring frequent walking in operational areas to identify problems or hazards with exposure to hazardous materials in some site locations.

## ENVIRONMENTAL ELEMENTS

Office environment with moderate noise levels, controlled temperature conditions, and no direct exposure to hazardous physical substances.

Field work with exposure to loud noise levels, cold and hot temperatures, inclement weather conditions, road hazards, and vibration.

Employees may interact with upset staff and/or public and private representatives in interpreting and enforcing departmental policies and procedures.

## OTHER REQUIRMENTS

Probationary Period: All OC San employees, except classifications considered “at-will”, are subject to the probationary period provisions as specified in the applicable Memorandum of Understanding, policies, and/or resolutions. Employees who have not yet successfully completed their initial probationary period serve “at-will” and may be released from employment without cause or recourse to any appeal or grievance procedures.

Pre-Employment: All employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of OC San’s pre-employment process, which includes a background investigation, a physical examination, and a drug screen.

Work Location Assignment: Employees will be assigned to a work location based on business needs which may be located at any/all of OC San locations; this work location may be changed at any time.

## DISASTER SERVICE WORKER

All Orange County Sanitation District employees are designated Disaster Service Workers through state law (California Government Code Section 3100-3109). Employment with the Orange County Sanitation District requires the affirmation of a loyalty oath to this effect. Employees are required to complete all related training as assigned, and to return to work as ordered in the event of an emergency.

# Medical Office Assistant (Site Lead)

$28 - $30 per hour

Salma Health, Inc.

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7044722843085364952?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=8784970026860904374&crId=US_0US_0)

The Front Desk Medical Assistant / Site Lead plays a dual role that combines exceptional patient-facing service with operational and clinical support. This individual will ensure smooth day-to-day clinic operations, provide hands‑on support to patients and providers, and oversee site‑level coordination and administration.

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, and thrives in a dynamic outpatient environment. This position is essential in maintaining efficient workflows, supporting clinical staff, and fostering a collaborative, patient‑centered atmosphere that reflects our mission and values.

Key Responsibilities
Front Desk & Patient Support

Welcome patients and serve as the first point of contact at the clinic, providing a warm and professional experience.

Manage scheduling, check‑in, check‑out, and respond to phone and email inquiries.

Collect and verify insurance, demographic, and intake information while maintaining accurate documentation in the EHR.

Ensure smooth patient flow and maintain a well‑organized waiting area.

Clinical & Administrative Support

Assist providers with patient rooming, obtaining vitals, and other basic medical assistant (MA) tasks as needed.

Coordinate with virtual assistants and central support teams for scheduling, billing, and prior authorizations.

Support onboarding and training of new front desk or MA staff to ensure consistent quality and compliance.

Monitor supply levels, submit orders, and maintain readiness of clinical and administrative areas.

Escalate operational issues (facilities, IT, patient concerns) to leadership in a timely manner.

Site Lead Responsibilities

Serve as the point person for daily operations at the Fremont clinic.

Partner with Clinical Operations leadership to implement new workflows and EHR processes.

Collaborate with regional leaders on staffing schedules and clinic readiness.

Track and report basic operational metrics (e.g., patient volume, cancellations, turnaround times).

Ensure compliance with all clinic protocols, safety standards, and regulatory requirements.

Promote teamwork and a supportive, patient‑centered environment for both staff and patients.

Support billing coordination and communication with central billing teams.

Required Qualifications

Medical Assistant certification required, or equivalent experience in a hybrid clinical/front desk role.

5+ years of experience in a medical office, preferably in outpatient or mental health care settings and 1 + year of managing a medical office

Strong organizational and multitasking skills with attention to detail.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a professional and empathetic demeanor.

Proficiency with EHR systems and comfort using technology‑enabled workflows.

Demonstrated ability to balance patient care responsibilities with site‑level administrative oversight.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting multi‑provider or multi‑location clinic operations.

Familiarity with behavioral health workflows and patient coordination.

Schedule
Full‑time, Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–5:00 PM, on‑site at the Fremont clinic.

Company Mission & Vision
We are the brain health company of the future that integrates care delivery, technology innovation, and research breakthroughs to better understand brain biology and diagnose, treat, and ultimately cure brain disorders for all stages of life.

Who We Are
Salma Health is reimagining brain healthcare. We bring together advanced diagnostics, evidence‑based treatments and continuous support under one connected system—so every person can receive the right care at the right moment.

Our multidisciplinary team of psychiatrists, neurologists, neuropsychiatrists, therapists and technologists work together to deliver personalized, compassionate care for people living with brain and mental health conditions. By combining cutting‑edge science with human understanding, we’re creating a new model of care that replaces fragmentation with connection and uncertainty with clarity.

Headquartered in California, Salma Health is expanding access to innovative brain health care across the U.S., beginning with clinics in San Diego, Orange County, and clinics in the Bay Area and Los Angeles opening soon.

Compensation & Benefits

Hourly Wage: $28‑$30 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.

Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, PTO, and additional benefits.

We reserve the right to modify benefit offerings at any time, in accordance with applicable laws.

Work Authorization
Sponsorship for employment authorization may be considered on a case‑by‑case basis depending on the role and candidate qualifications.

Equal Opportunity & Accessibility Statement
We are committed to providing a workplace that is inclusive, respectful, and free from discrimination. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by California or federal law.

In accordance with the California Fair Chance Act , we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

# Security Administrative Assistant

$27 - $34 per hour

Stratolaunch Manufacturing Facility operated by Scaled Composites

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7651949701944035198?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2849048705013384914&crId=US_0US_0)

Stratolaunch accelerates the development of next-generation aerospace and defense technologies through reusable hypersonic flight testing. Our autonomous, air-launched Talon-A vehicles provide access to operationally realistic flight environments at speeds exceeding Mach 5, delivering critical data that helps customers validate system performance and advance technologies toward deployment. Our team brings together expertise in engineering, manufacturing, and flight operations to solve complex challenges and advance capabilities essential to national security.
POSITION SUMMARY The Security Administrative Assistant will report to the Facility Security Officer. The Security Administrative Assistant will assist Stratolaunch guests and remote employees as they visit the site. This role will require superb customer service and a positive attitude.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Monitor visitor access in conjunction with the Facility Security Officer.
Maintain Master Visitor Control Calendar
Maintain accurate records within SwipedOn
Manage Tour Requests
Receive and verifies guests, vendors, suppliers and coordinates documents for their visits
Conducts screening programs such as Denied Party Screenings
Issues and tracks visitor badges, new hire badges and temporary badges
Conduct daily badge audits and follows-up with any missing badges
Greet and welcome guests as soon as they arrive. Notifies company personnel of visitor arrival and logs their entry/departure into a visitor control database
Place maintenance requests as needed
Assist with shipping items to remote employees, as needed
Distribute mail
Perform lobby hosting duties, as needed
Demonstrate honesty, responsibility, integrity and fulfillment of commitments
Become familiar with the Access Control System
Manage Non-Employee Badge Agreements, tracking Temp Hires, Contractors, Long Term Visitors
Route all corporate phone calls/check voicemails on main line
Assist the Security Department with tracking Security Education & Training
Perform additional duties as assigned
QUALIFICATIONS To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Knowledge, experience, skill, and/or ability Daily attendance at our Mojave, CA site
Knowledge of general office practices, procedures and equipment
Ability to read, write and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos
Team-oriented individual who can work well and communicate with various people
Excellent follow-through and attention to detail
Well organized self-starter who can grasp and complete tasks with little supervision
Experience interacting with senior level management and prior customer service experience a plus
Must be able to remain calm, cool, and have a positive attitude under pressure
Must be physically able to lift or push (on a cart) up to 30 lbs.
Demonstrate the highest level of integrity and have a commitment to maintain confidentiality
Demonstrate the willingness to take on more responsibilities and projects as time progresses
MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
Education/experience/certifications High school diploma or General Education Degree (GED); and 2-4 plus years relevant experience, OR equivalent combination of education and experience
$27.00-$34.00/hr.
Special remarks regarding work environment This position is located in Mojave, CA
May support Flight Tests as needed
Base salary and leveling are established on a case-by-case basis. We consider several factors to ensure a competitive offer, including your location, educational background, and a comprehensive assessment of the skills and experience demonstrated during your interviews. Benefits and our location(s) Paid Maternity and Parental Leave
50% company match per contributed dollar into 401(k) savings plan, up to $11,500
This position may involve the operation of company vehicles as part of assigned duties.
Mojave Air & Spaceport is located just outside of Lancaster/Palmdale and is only 95 miles north of Los Angeles. The area offers both affordability and central access to a variety of California's best attractions and landmarks.
Not much for the outdoors and prefer the city life? You’re within a half day’s drive or less of Los Angeles, San Diego, Las Vegas, and San Francisco where you can find a variety of live entertainment, museums, tours, and historical sight-seeing. Theme parks are in abundance, with Six Flags Magic Mountain, Disneyland, and Knotts Berry Farm ready to meet the needs of rollercoaster thrill seekers.
Food and drink fanatics are in a haven of delectable choices. Wine aficionados will also find easy access to some of the state’s best vino in Paso Robles, Santa Ynez, and even more locally in Tehachapi and Agua Dulce. Beer fanatics will find some of the best West Coast IPAs at Bravery and Lucky Luke’s in Lancaster. Any food option you crave is covered, and we always recommend the authentic and fresh Mexican food that you won’t find anywhere else in the United States.

# Medical Receptionist

TradeJobsWorkForce

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7679033386660423459?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5807291087542679867&crId=US_0US_0)

Medical Receptionist Job Duties: Serves patients by greeting and helping them, scheduling appointments, and maintaining records and accounts.

Welcomes patients and visitors in person or on the telephone, and answering or referring inquiries.

Optimizes patients' satisfaction, provider time, and treatment room utilization by scheduling appointments in person or by telephone.

Keeps patient appointments on schedule by notifying provider of patient's arrival, reviewing service delivery compared to schedule, and reminding providers of service delays.

Comforts patients by anticipating patients' anxieties, answering patients' questions, and maintaining the reception area.

### Job Description

Job Description

**About the Role:**

Central California Appellate Program is looking for a detail-oriented and personable Receptionist / Case Processor to join our team in Sacramento, CA. This is a unique opportunity to play a vital role in the legal process, supporting appellate work that makes a real difference in people's lives. If you thrive in a professional environment and enjoy keeping things organized and running smoothly, we want to hear from you!

**Responsibilities:**

- Greet and assist visitors in a professional and welcoming manner
- Answer and route incoming phone calls, emails, and correspondence
- Open, track, and process incoming mail with accuracy and attention to detail
- Data entry in case and document management systems
- Read and classify documents
- Coordinate with staff to ensure timely case processing and deadlines are met
- Manage mail distribution and general front-desk operations

**Requirements:**

- Prior experience in a receptionist, legal assistant, or administrative support role preferred
- Familiarity with legal terminology, court processes, or appellate procedures is a plus
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
- Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and comfortable learning case management software
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- High level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information
- High school diploma or equivalent required; associate's or bachelor's degree preferred
- Ability to lift 30 pounds

**About Us:**

Central California Appellate Program (CCAP) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to providing high-quality appellate representation to indigent clients throughout California. Our team of skilled attorneys and staff are passionate about justice and committed to ensuring that every client receives a fair and thorough review of their case. Working at CCAP means being part of a mission-driven organization where your contributions truly matter.

# Human Resources Assistant 3

$26.34 - $45.4 per hour

University of California- Davis Health

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/7004776815005254236?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6482627056714739899&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Summary

Under the general direction of the Compensation Analyst 4 Supervisor, this position provides administrative, technical, project, and analytical support for compensation and classification programs and services. Serving as an initial point of contact for the Compensation unit, the incumbent collaborates with department managers, supervisors, Human Resources professionals across UC Davis Health, including the School of Medicine and School of Nursing, union representatives, and employees to provide guidance and support on issues regarding classification and compensation.

This position routinely receives, handles, and has access to highly sensitive and confidential compensation, classification, and labor relations information. The incumbent is entrusted with non-public materials involving bargaining unit determinations, accretion petitions, labor relations matters, and other confidential personnel issues. Responsibilities require the exercise of sound judgment, discretion, professionalism, and strict confidentiality in handling information in accordance with university policies, collective bargaining obligations, and applicable laws and regulations.

### Minimum Qualifications

- Two (2) years of progressively responsible administrative and/or human resources experience involving records management, data analysis, customer service, process coordination, and the handling of confidential information.
- Experience utilizing office applications such as Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, reporting platforms, database or HR information systems.
- Experience working in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities and deadlines.
- Ability to maintain a high degree of accuracy, attention to detail, and data integrity while managing sensitive and confidential information.
- Strong analytical, research, and problem‑solving skills to gather, evaluate, interpret, and analyze information; develop solutions; and exercise sound judgment in resolving issues.
- Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills to effectively gather information, respond to inquiries, explain policies and procedures, and interact with diverse stakeholders in a professional and diplomatic manner.
- Ability to independently organize, prioritize, coordinate, and manage multiple assignments and projects in a fast-paced environment with competing deadlines and changing priorities.
- Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships and collaborate effectively with employees, supervisors, managers, Human Resources professionals, labor representatives, and external stakeholders.
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to develop and maintain effective recordkeeping, tracking, filing, and information management systems.
- Proven ability to exercise discretion, maintain strict confidentiality, adapt to changing business needs, and learn new systems, processes, and technologies.

### Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting compensation, classification, human resources, labor relations, payroll, or workforce administration functions within a large, complex organization.
- Experience with UC Path, Salesforce (Aggie Service), Job Builder, Tableau, OnBase, Cognos reporting or similar/related systems.
- Basic knowledge of classification and compensation principles, practices, policies, procedures, and fundamental human resources concepts.
- Knowledge of UC Davis Health Human Resources functions, organizational structure, and key stakeholder relationships, including Compensation Services, Talent Acquisition, Health SSO, Labor Relations, the UC Davis Medical Center, the School of Medicine, and the School of Nursing.

### Key Responsibilities

- 40% – Receipt, Tracking and Distribution of Compensation and Classification Actions
- 20% – Compensation and Classification Systems, Data Management, and Reporting
- 15% – Project Support
- 15% – Administrative and Operational Support
- 5% – Requests for Information (RFIs) and Litigation Support
- 5% – Professional and Personal Growth

### Department Overview

Health Compensation Services administers classification and compensation programs across UC Davis Health which includes the Medical Center, School of Medicine, and School of Nursing and serves as consultative partners to managers, department leaders, supervisors and HR Business Partners. The department is responsible for maintaining salary administration throughout the organization; evaluating and determining classifications and compensation for new and occupied staff positions; conducting labor market analysis; administering equity and stipend programs; and implementing wage and salary programs. Health Compensation Services also prepares and presents salary and economic proposals on behalf of the University during local and systemwide collective bargaining processes, ensuring equitable, competitive, and compliant compensation practices that support organizational goals and workforce excellence.

LEGENDS GLOBAL

Legends Global redefines excellence in sports, entertainment, and live events. We combine unmatched expertise with a global reach, offering end-to-end solutions - from venue development, venue management, and event booking to revenue strategy and hospitality.

Legends Global brings a 360-degree, data-driven approach across Global Partnerships, Hospitality, Merchandise, and Attractions, working with top-tier clients to deliver exceptional experiences.

Our organization is committed to building an inclusive, innovative environment where differences drive solutions that benefit our team members, guests, and partners. Guided by our values of respect, integrity, and accountability, we create a workplace where everyone can succeed. Are you ready to be part of the team that is transforming live entertainment? Join us to make legends happen!

Responsibilities

• Collects and validates time-keeping records for non-exempt staff.

• Prepares venue payroll in a timely and accurate manner. Includes recording and processing of hours of work, maintaining payroll controls, records, and support.

• Data processing in HRIS and Time & Attendance system • Review and process employee new hire/rehire information and terminations.

• Responsible for accuracy of all payrolls.

• Ensures all payroll forms are distributed, received, recorded, and filed as appropriate.

• Provides customer service to all internal employees and outside contacts. Qualifications

• Must have solid understanding of payroll processes and procedures • Must have proficiency in Microsoft Excel

• General knowledge of basic accounting practices • Excellent Customer Service and communication skills

• Able to maintain a high level of confidentiality

• Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment and stadium event schedule

• Ability to work effectively in a team environment

• Experience with Ultimate Software (ABI / Workday) Systems preferred

• Other accounting related tasked may be assigned as needed.

Practice safe work habits, follow all safety policies and procedures and regulations, complete company-wide safety training and any additional job-specific safety training. Legends is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, or genetic information.

Compensation:

Full-time $28-32 per hour

$62.62k - $69.04k

North Bay Regional Center

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4925255333295839361?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7268740630928203016&crId=US_0US_0)

Salary Range $62,616 – $69,036 with opportunities for 5% increases annually
Company Overview At North Bay Regional Center, we believe all people with developmental disabilities should have the same opportunities as are available to all other citizens. As one of the 21 nonprofit Regional Centers throughout California, we offer a comprehensive program supporting the needs of our communities, provided by driven and passionate employees who ensure we achieve our goals daily.
Who We Serve North Bay Regional Center (NBRC) provides advocacy, services, support, and care coordination to children and adults diagnosed with intellectual and developmental disabilities and their families in Napa, Sonoma and Solano counties. We partner with community-based organizations and agencies to empower our clients to thrive and live as independently as possible within the geographically, culturally, and ethnically diverse communities we serve. North Bay Regional Center serves over 13,000 people living within the geographic boundaries of Napa, Sonoma and Solano counties.
Note: Bilingual Spanish/English skills are preferred.
DEFINITION Under the supervision of the Director of Administrative Services, the Payroll Coordinator processes all payroll and mileage reimbursements for North Bay Regional Center employees. Responsible for all employee and supervisor training regarding proper time entry and time sheet management. Audits and processes employee benefit billing. May be responsible for implementation and oversight of special projects.
NATURE OF WORK: Working closely with the Senior Human Resources Generalist, this is a technical level support position which involves the performance of all functions related to payroll processing. Works with confidential information including all processing of payroll functions, related health benefits calculation/payments, tax sheltered annuities, retirement, COBRA, employee data, verification of employment, and any payments and/or reports for the benefit of the agency as deemed confidential and or necessary. Maintains various tracking reports and statistical reports. Responsible for the oversight and completion of special assignments. Will train employees and supervisors on proper timesheet entry. Manages timesheets for employees on full-time leave of absence. Performs assignments with limited supervision, using accurate and independent judgement.
EXAMPLES OF WORK: Reviews time sheets for accuracy, audits employee health benefits, maintains all voluntary payroll deductions and benefits with payment to third parties (if applicable), audits records for accuracy and completeness, completes calculations and prepares summary reports. Processes payroll for the entire agency, collects statistical information. Ensures all payroll records are in compliance with various audit requirements. Other duties as assigned related to payroll and time keeping management.
Requirements MINIMUM EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: Three to four years of experience in payroll processing in an organization with 100+ employees.
AND Completion of one year of college, in Business, Human Resources Management or related field, is strongly preferred
KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES: Knowledge of basic payroll, human resource, employment law related principles and regulations as well as accounting integration using a HRIS/Payroll application, with Paylocity preferred; ability to analyze computer transactions/reports for errors and completeness; knowledge of general office methods, practices and procedures; principles and practices of financial record keeping; ability to type 30 WPM; ability to operate calculator and computer; ability to make calculations rapidly and accurately; ability to express oneself well verbally and in writing. Ability to respond professionally and timely to employee questions and requests.
SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS: Ability to provide personal automobile transportation, or access to another form of reliable transportation, during and after working hours.
If operating own vehicle, provide minimum automobile liability insurance as required by California Law.
This position will be primarily based in the office, however, a hybrid work arrangement may also be available after several months of demonstrated acceptable performance.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Maintain a current workload with complete and accurate documentation.
Ability and knowledge of basic payroll and human resource principles and integration with a computer system.
Perform payroll work accurately and on time, in accordance with NBRC’s payroll dates.
Prepare and process final pay for exiting employees.
Complete verifications of employment.
Review, audit, and remit employee benefit payments, i.e., retirement, dental, vision, etc.
Actively participate in all team/unit meetings and required trainings.
Attend all meetings with punctuality.
Maintain current workload with accurate and complete documentation.
Interact tactfully and effectively with those contacted in the course of work.
Read, interpret and follow policies, procedures, laws, and regulations.
Communicate effectively in person, on the telephone and in writing.
Organize, prioritize and coordinate work activities.
Perform work under stressful conditions, as required.
Use initiative and sound, independent judgment within established guidelines.
Make decisions with a minimum of direction.
Analyze and find effective solutions to problems.
Notify supervisor of schedule changes, i.e., use of accrued time-off benefits.
Adhere to a reliable work schedule, i.e., punctuality in reporting to work and in using consistent sign-out methods.
Accurate and timely recording on time sheet and mileage forms.
Represent the agency's philosophy, policies, and standards in a professional manner in the community and in the office.
Maintain a high level of personal and professional conduct.
Other duties as assigned.

CalPERS Retirement Plan
CalPERS Medical Insurance Plans, with generous employer contributions
Dental Insurance, with zero cost for employee only coverage
Vision Insurance, with $5/month employee cost share for employee only coverage
Flexible Spending Accounts for Medical and Dependent Care
100% Employer Paid Life Insurance
Generous vacation and sick accrual policies
Employee Referral Reward Program
16 Paid Agency Holidays/year
CalPERS 457 Supplemental Retirement Plan
